create_ghost_module: create a GhostModule that generates extra feature maps from cheap operations using primary and depthwise convolutions
build_ghost_bottleneck_block: build a GhostBottleneckBlock with expansion, SE squeeze-excitation, and residual connection for mobile vision models
register_gb_primitive: register the gb_k3_r2 GhostBottleneckBlock primitive with ratio 2 into the PRIMITIVES factory registry
run_ghost_module_forward: run the GhostModule forward pass to concatenate primary conv output with cheap depthwise operation output
run_ghost_bottleneck_forward: run the GhostBottleneckBlock forward pass through pw, shuffle, dw, se, pwl, and residual connection stages
